project.summary: Unified notification push plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 27 outbound channels, bidirectional remote approval and conversation across six IM platforms, official QR login for QQ/DingTalk/Feishu, multi-agent routing, and a loopback-only web admin console — zero runtime dependencies.

release.compatibility: DeepSeek Harness dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 official baseline; peer dependency @deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1; Node >=22; zero runtime dependencies (fetch + node:crypto + native WebSocket only).
release.changelog: 0.4.0: system desktop notifications — a native-command desktop channel (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send / Windows PowerShell BurntToast, spawned without a shell) plus an admin-console Notifications page (SSE event stream, browser system notifications and sound); tests 588 -> 625. Prior releases deliver 27 channels, level-based routing, bidirectional remote approval and conversation over Telegram/Feishu/QQ/WxPusher/WeChat/DingTalk, official QR login, multi-agent routing, and the web admin console.

management.label: DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin (dsh-notifier)
management.instructions: Add the dsh-notifier package to a DeepSeek Harness profile; its bundle patch (cordis.patch.yml) inserts the dsh-notifier row and the notify and notify_test tools register when the plugin applies. Configure outbound channels under config.channels, and optional admin.enabled, inbound.*, and routing.* keys, in the profile overlay. The web admin console binds 127.0.0.1 only and requires a Bearer token.

declarations.permissions: Registers two model-facing tools (notify, notify_test; harness:tool) and subscribes to DSH session and agent runtime events for auto-push and remote approval/conversation (harness:event); makes outbound HTTPS requests to 27 notification channels and QQ/Feishu/DingTalk/Telegram APIs (network:outbound); binds a loopback-only admin HTTP server plus inbound callback endpoints (network:listen); persists a local state store, approval ledger, and token vault (file:read, file:write); the desktop channel spawns native notification binaries without a shell (subprocess:exec, shell:none); stores scan-login credentials and channel secrets locally (credentials:write).
declarations.testing: 625 node:test tests across 37 test files pass (channel adapters and spec engine, signers, inbound adapters and approvals, routing, admin API/SSE/UI wiring, ledger, rate limiting, tool registration, plugin entry); CI runs a three-platform matrix (ubuntu/windows/macos) aligned with Node >=22. Channel delivery is validated against in-process mock servers; no external service is contacted.

capability.invocation: invoke the model-facing notify tool with a message and an optional target channel through the DSH ToolRuntime
capability.expected: the message is delivered to the configured channel (e.g. Telegram) and a structured result is returned; an unreachable or unconfigured channel returns a structured skipped/failed result without blocking the turn
